code:
stages:
  - build:
      run: msbuild MyDatabase.sqlproj
  - deploy_test:
      needs: build
      run: SqlPackage.exe /TargetDatabaseName:TestDb
  - test:
      needs: deploy_test
      run: ./smoke-tests.ps1 -Database TestDb
  - deploy_prod:
      needs: test
      environment: production
caption: Each stage only runs if the one before it succeeded.
